one_liner: Create posts, retrieve media and profiles, moderate replies, and access insights on Threads.
auth_notes: API authentication is handled by Threads user access tokens that conform to the OAuth 2.0 protocol.
access_notes: Sign up for a free Meta developer account and create a Meta app with the Threads API use case.
api_notes: REST API endpoints via graph.threads.com or graph.threads.net covering user profiles, media, publishing, replies, and insights.
blocker_notes: Publicly available APIs with self-serve free developer access.

reasons.auth: Threads API uses OAuth 2.0 user access tokens (Bearer tokens) as documented in the Get Started guide.
reasons.access: Developers can create an app and enable the Threads use case to obtain short‑ and long‑lived user access tokens without a paid plan, as described in the Get Started and Get Access Tokens docs.
reasons.mcp: The API is documented on Meta’s official developers site (developers.facebook.com), indicating an official MCP.
reasons.verdict: Public documentation, OAuth 2.0 flow, and free self‑serve app creation allow a toolkit to be built today.
